richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries because, due to a faulty weld, the front axle may develop clicking noises. In extreme cases, the vehicle may go out of control.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type 350 (Lancia Musa, Fiat Idea), EC type-approval e3*2001/116*0153 and Type 843 (Lancia Ypsilon), EC type-approval e3*2001/116*0149.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of injuries because, due to a faulty weld, the front axle may develop clicking noises.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that; due to a possible lack of lubricant between the steering rack and pinion the steering may become increasingly stiff to operate. This can eventually lead to damage to the steering rack teeth. As a consequence the steering operation of the vehicle may become increasingly difficult.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering rack inspected for damage. If no damage is evident the rack and pinion will be lubricated. Should any damage be in evidence the steering rack will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: STEERING COULD BECOME INCREASINGLY STIFF.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the possibility exists that water may ingress into the front windscreen wiper motor. Should this occur the wipers may become inoperative. In conditions of poor visibility this may result in impaired driver visibility.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front windscreen wiper motor fitted with a protective cover.
richiami.titolo: FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to manufacture from an incorrect material the tyre inflation valve may break. Should this occur rapid deflation of the tyre and possible vehicle instability would occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the tyre inflation valve replaced on all steel wheels including the spare.
richiami.titolo: TYRE VALVE MAY BREAK  CAUSING RAPID DEFLATION (STEEL WHEELS)

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that corrosion may be present near the welds for the front suspension arm front mountings on the front cross member.Should this be the case in time this could lead to noise whilst driving and the possibility that the weld could fail. Failure of the weld may lead to loss of vehicle stability.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicle will be checked to ascertain whether corrosion is present near the front suspension mountings. If this is found to be the case the front cross member will be replaced. If corrosion is not present a front cross member strengthening kit will be fitted.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTINGS - FAILURE OF WELD

richiami.difetto: The product poses a serious risk of injuries because of a possible loss of control of the vehicle.There may in some cases be some interference between the right bearing of the differential gear with the differential gear cap due to excess casting material on the differential gear cap, resulting in the possible breakage of the bearing. Such a case could result in the driver not being able to use the gear box, leading to possible loss of control of vehicle.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Fiat Ducato x2/50 with 3.0 JTD diesel engine
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary recall from consumers and corrective actions taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front anti-roll bar bushes may wear after a period of time. Should this occur noise will be generated by contact between the anti-roll bar and the metal sleeve of the bush.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front anti-roll bar replaced.
richiami.titolo: ANTI-ROLL BAR BUSH WEAR

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the swivel joint stem of the front suspension vertical links maybe of an incorrect size. This can lead to the generation of noise whilst driving and the possibility of suspension disconnection following a violent impact to the front axle and subsequent loss of vehicle control.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the swivel joint stems checked for the presence of play and will be replaced if any is found.
richiami.titolo: STEERING SWIVEL  JOINT MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL

richiami.difetto: These vehicles pose a risk of injuries because the sound insulation of the engine chamber can overheat and ultimately catch fire.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Fiat Ducato X2/44 with 2,8 JTD engine and Fiat Multipla 1,9 Multijet engines
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: These vehicles pose a risk of injuries because the sound insulation of the engine chamber can overheat and ultimately catch fire.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to the inlet filter for the exhaust gas recirculating valve (EGR) being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This can give rise to the possibility of ice forming within the pipe during periods of low ambient temperature with the possibility of reduced brake servo assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR valve solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If this is not the case new solenoids with separate filters will be fitted.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because water, which turns into ice at low temperatures, can get into the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve damaging the valve and making it leaky. The valve is located on the intake manifold and plays a key role in reducing unwanted engine emissions. When the valve is flawed it can cause excessive emissions of exhaust gases, engine's choking and stalling while accelerating and finally lowering efficiency of the braking system.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: 2,2 JTD Fiat Ulysse of series from type 3001046 to 3201942, Lancia Phedra 2.0 of series from type 3002175 to 3202476
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary information to consumers and corrective actions taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: Fuel delivery pipe adjacent to air filter may chafe. This in time could lead to leakage of fuel in the engine compartment and a consequent risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel delivery pipe and where necessary replace the pipe containment channel.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Due to the inlet filter for the EGR valve being in an exposed position there is a possibility of water entering the brake servo vacuum pipe. This could result in the possibility of ice forming in the brake servo vacuum pipe in conditions of low ambient temperature. As a consequence this may lead to reduced servo assistance to the braking system.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the EGR solenoids checked for the presence of separate air filters. If theses are not evident new solenoids with separate air filters will be fitted.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the possibility exists that a disconnection of the handbrake cable may occur which can result in the handbrake becoming inefficient.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the fitment of the handbrake cable to the actuating lever checked. If found to be incorrect the situation  will be rectified. If the handbrake cable is found to be damaged it will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: Incorrect profile (flaring) of the end of the steering shaft at the upper steering column universal joint. This may give the possibility of the steering column becoming disconnected from the universal joint with a consequent loss of vehicle steering.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to inspect the profile and flaring of the end of the steering shaft at the upper universal joint and where necessary renew the shaft.
richiami.titolo: STEERING COLUMN MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED

richiami.difetto: This product poses a risk of fire because a petrol pipe which rubs against air filter trunk may be damaged. This can result in petrol leakage in the engine chamber.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Panda Multijet. Cars produced in the period between July 2005 and January 2006 having series numbers from 445385 to 573368.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: This product poses a risk of fire because a petrol pipe which rubs against air filter trunk may be damaged.

richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley inspected and changed should this be necessary.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE POWER MAY BE LOST

richiami.difetto: This product poses a serious risk of fire because the ABS welds are leaky thus water intrusion is possible. Water intrusion may cause short circuit and car ignition.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Fiat Panda with ABS (Anti-Blocking System). Cars equipped with ABS produced in the period between June 2003 and November 2006. Cars of series from the beginning of type to 797330.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the possibility exists that breakage of the dropside hinge fastening plate may occur on vehicles fitted with a factory installed dropside body. This can result in the detachment of the dropside panel.
richiami.rimedio: Subject vehicles will be recalled at which time the hinge fastening plates will be changed.
richiami.titolo: DROPSIDE PANEL MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: Due to the incorrect profiling of a rigid fuel pipe at the quick fit connection with the flexible fuel pipe for the injection manifold. The possibility exists that a fuel leak may develop at the connector and result in a fire in the engine compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have a locking insert fitted within the quick fit connector in order to prevent the connector from becoming loose.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK AND RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the chassis front cross member may have a weld which does not conform to specification. This may lead to a creaking noise being heard under braking and could in time lead to the cross member cracking in the area of it's mounting to the vehicle's body.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front cross member replaced.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBER MAY FRACTURE

richiami.difetto: Under environmental conditions that require the intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits may infiltrate the rubber plate which supports the front suspension springs initiating seats of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
richiami.rimedio: To avoid damage to a tyre in the event of spring breakage a plate will be fitted which will contain the spring.
richiami.titolo: SUSPENSION COIL SPRINGS MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of accident and injury because the front axle springs can break, come in contact with and damage the tyres. Road salt deposits on the spring plate can cause severe corrosion and fracture the spring. The broken spring may touch the tyres and damage them.Some cases of damage to the vehicle have been reported.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the producer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of accident and injury because the front axle springs can break, come in contact with and damage the tyres.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the weld on the steering shaft at the lower universal joint fitting maybe absent.  If there is an absent of the weld at the joint this may lead to a loss of steering.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and inspect steering shaft to ensure weld is present if not renew steering shaft.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING

richiami.difetto: The U bolts securing the leaf spring to the rear axle may not have been tightened to the correct torque. This may result in the U bolts breaking.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the U bolts checked to ensure there is no damage and that they have been tightened to the correct torque.
richiami.titolo: U-BOLTS ON REAR AXLE MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: It may be possible for the handbrake cable to foul the rigid brake pipe at the right hand rear suspension arm. In time this could lead to wear of the rigid brake pipe and as a consequence there maybe a loss of brake fluid and longer stopping distances.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the routing of the handbrake cable and fit rubber pads to the rigid brake pipe to prevent fouling.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Under environmental conditions that require intensive use of salt on the roads corrosive deposits accumulate inside the noise-insulating protective sheath located on the front suspension springs creating areas of corrosion which may lead to the spring breaking after a period of time.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front coil springs with those of a new type.
richiami.titolo: SUSPENSION COIL SPRING MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: In some cases due to the non compliant routing of the brake servo vacuum supply pipe damage to the pipe may occur with the possibility that braking assistance might be reduced.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject pipe checked and re-routed. Should any damage be found the pipe will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM PIPE MAY BE INCORRECT

richiami.difetto: The air conditioning condenser drainpipe may in some instances become blocked with the possibility that the condensate may leak into the passenger compartment and the air bag central control unit. This contamination may cause the air bag warning light to illuminate and in some cases; cause inadvertent activation of the air bag.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the condensate drainpipe will be refitted; and re-profiled to remove any restriction.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF INADVERTENT AIRBAG ACTIVATION

richiami.difetto: It is possible for the fastenings of the sound deadening guard to become loose. Consequently the guard could become detached whilst the vehicle is in motion.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all the fastenings with new captive fasteners and bolts.
richiami.titolo: SOUND DEADENING GUARD MAY BECOME DETACHED

richiami.difetto: In some cases due to the non-compliance of the engine ECU software the engine failure warning lamp may illuminate. As a consequence the vacuum assistance available to the braking system may be reduced.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the engine ECU with updated software.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE VACUUM ASSISTANCE MAY REDUCE

richiami.difetto: Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING

richiami.difetto: Excess play between steering rack and pinion leading to noise and possible loss of steering when parking.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the steering pinion bearing preload adjusted or the steering rack assembly will be replaced as necessary
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING

richiami.difetto: The rear seat belt anchorage points do not conform to specification which could in the event of a collision result in the insecurity of the seat belt.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and upgrade the seat belt anchorage to the correct specification by the fitment of an additional bracket.
richiami.titolo: REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE POINT NOT CONFORMING

richiami.difetto: The brake hoses may chafe on the wheel aches and in extreme cases cause a brake fluid  leak. The driver will be informed of the defect by the illumination of a warning lamp on the dashboard. If ignored then this will result in longer than expected stopping distances.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and visually inspect the front brake hoses reinforcement and protection. The brake hoses if worn will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDS AND EXTENDED PEDAL TRAVEL

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the accelerator may foul on the floor mounted pedal stop
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified throttle pedal stop.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL COULD FOUL ON THE FLOOR

richiami.difetto: Possibility of fuel leakage from the fuel tank due to corrosion
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the fuel tank will be inspected for corrosion. Should corrosion be found the fuel tank will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE FROM FUEL TANK DUE TO CORROSION

richiami.difetto: Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary
richiami.titolo: FRONT HUB SECURITY

richiami.difetto: Front hub nut security pin may have been incorrectly fitted.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check for correct fitment of pin and replace if necessary
richiami.titolo: FRONT HUB SECURITY

richiami.difetto: Offside front brake hose may chafe
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check and fit new pipe if necessary
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE PIPE

richiami.difetto: Electric Sliding door may open inadvertently.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and upgrade door control system ECU.
richiami.titolo: ELECTRIC SLIDING REAR DOOR

richiami.difetto: The lower engine stabiliser rod may crack or break. This could result in detachment of the off side drive shaft on full lock.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect the stabiliser rod welding and fit a new rod where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF LOWER ENGINE STABILISER ROD

richiami.difetto: Water ingress into the airbag control unit (ECU) could result in illumination of the warning light and in the worst case unintentional deployment of the airbag.
richiami.rimedio: Seal the airbag ECU compartment
richiami.titolo: WATER INGRESS INTO THE AIRBAG ECU

richiami.difetto: It is possible for the side window air bags to deploy unintentionally.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the air bag central control unit.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENDED  ACTIVATION OF SIDE WINDOW AIRBAGS

richiami.difetto: A short circuit may occur in the engine cooling fan control unit with a resultant risk of overheating.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a new cooling fan control unit.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT IN ENGINE COOLING FAN CONTROL UNIT

richiami.difetto: The interior fan wiring may chafe on a dashboard support.  This could result in a short circuit and a fire in the fan unit.
richiami.rimedio: Fit additional insulation and protection to the fan electrical  wiring.
richiami.titolo: INTERIOR FAN WIRING MAY CHAFE ON DASHBOARD SUPPORT

richiami.difetto: The road wheel fixing bolts may not have been correctly torqued and could loosen over a period of use.
richiami.rimedio: Check the wheel fixing bolts for correct torque and tighten or renew as appropriate.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT TORQUE OF WHEEL BOLTS

richiami.difetto: Water may enter the ABS (antilock brake) control unit through a harness connector. This will cause the ABS control unit to malfunction and the fault warning lamp to illuminate.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a new ABS wiring harness which has watertight connectors.
richiami.titolo: WATER INGRESS TO ABS CONTROL UNIT

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the control solenoids may not function in very cold temperatures resulting in loss of servo assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace control solenoids and fit weather shield.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: The electrical wiring loom may chafe on the steering column and cause the unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag.
richiami.rimedio: Check wiring loom for damage and reposition it clear of the steering column.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG

richiami.difetto: The handbrake cable may have been incorrectly fitted and could become disconnected from the rear brake mechanism.  This would result in the handbrake becoming ineffective.
richiami.rimedio: Check that the handbrake cable is correctly connected to the rear brake mechanism and fit a new cable where it is not.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The accelerator pedal may foul on its travel limiting stop and prevent the engine from decellerating when the pedal is released.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a modified pedal travel limiting stop.
richiami.titolo: ACCELERATOR PEDAL CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.
richiami.titolo: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to an incorrect specification the steering arms when subjected to unusual stress such as an impact may break.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace steering arms with correct specification type.
richiami.titolo: STEERING ARMS MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: Possible water ingress into the electronic control unit (ECU) could result in unintentional deployment of the drivers air bag and passengers air bag where fitted.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check for water ingress into the ECU and replace if necessary. Fit water protection to the ECU in all cases.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENDED DEPLOYMENT OF AIR BAG

richiami.difetto: Prolonged exposure to the effects of road salt corrosion may result in perforation of the metal brake pipes and a consequential loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Replace corroded brake pipes and apply corrosion prevention treatment to all brake pipes.
richiami.titolo: CORROSION OF METAL BRAKE PIPES

richiami.difetto: The power assisted steering low pressure pipe may chafe on a hose clip.  This could result in the loss of the hydraulic fluid and power assistance of the steering.
richiami.rimedio: Check the steering low pressure hydraulic pipe for damage and reposition the hose clip where necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER STEERING

richiami.difetto: Brake vacuum pump drive coupling dog may fail as a result of breakage. This could result in a loss of power assistance at the brake pedal.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to fit a quality assured replacement drive pin to the vacuum pump.
richiami.titolo: VACUUM PUMP DRIVE PIN

richiami.difetto: Fuel tank rear mountings may not inadequately secure the tank with a risk of possible disengagement.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcement plates to rear tank mountings.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK MOUNTINGS

richiami.difetto: Possible chafing of front rigid brake pipes at near side front against the plastic wheel arch liner or against the gearbox mounting. Also at the off side front against the engine timing belt cover.
richiami.rimedio: Reposition any chafing brake pipe to comply with the manufacturer's prescribed clearance between adjacent parts. Renew any brake pipe that has been chafed beyond a serviceable condition.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CHAFING OF BRAKE PIPES.

richiami.difetto: The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and reposition re-circulation pipe away from compressor pulley.
richiami.titolo: FUEL VAPOUR RE- CIRCULATION PIPE MAY BECOME DAMAGED

richiami.difetto: The fuel vapour re-circulation pipe could foul against the air-conditioning compressor pulley resulting in possible damage to the pipe and the risk of fire.

richiami.difetto: The anti noise plastic shields fitted to the bottom of the front suspension coil springs may permit the accumulation of a high level of humidity under certain environmental conditions. When combined with the presence of salt and small stones etc. this condition may cause breakage of the spring(s) and subsequent tearing of the tyre as a result of the fractured coils contacting the tyre wall.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of a modified ventilated spring sheath and inspection of the front coil springs.
richiami.titolo: FRACTURE OF FRONT COIL SPRINGS

richiami.difetto: On some Punto vehicles it has been found that the seat belt pre-tensioners may fail to activate although normal activation of the seat belt is assured.

richiami.difetto: On batteries fitted with non-watertight caps rainwater from the windscreen may run into the battery and result in a leakage of battery contents. This leakage may damage the adjacent fabric reinforced rubber brake servo pipe and reduce or cancel the servo assistance available when braking.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have a cover fitted to the battery and checking of the brake servo pipe for damage.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: A defective retaining clip may allow the throttle cable to chafe against certain rigid brake pipes. This could damage the pipes and result in a reduction in braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the subject retaining clip replaced with a modified version.

richiami.titolo: BRAKE PIPE DAMAGE

richiami.difetto: A number of the subject vehicles have been fitted with seat belts manufactured by TRW the attachment systems of which may not remain secure in an accident situation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles check the date of production on the seat belt buckles and replace those within the critical batch.
richiami.titolo: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT
